evidence_quotes: Determinação para que a prefeitura e o particular réu paguem os valores aos autores para o desassoreamento do lago.
geraram o assoreamento do lago existente na propriedade dos autores.
rationale: The TJSP decision directly adjudicates water-body degradation (lake siltation / assoreamento do lago) resulting from unauthorized deforestation and road-clearing in a permanent preservation area (APP), ordering the municipality and private developer to pay the costs of dredging/desilting the lake (desassoreamento do lago). Because it involves direct physical degradation and remediation of a surface water body rather than purely abstract land-use zoning in a manancial zone, both mananciais_calibrated_label and strict_service_access_label are WATER, categorized under environmental_protection.
